text: Steps (2) (3) can combined single step convenience function: runDrugResponseProcessingPipeline. Moreover, output MultiAssayExperiment object one experiment per detected data type. title: Run a gDR report pipeline — run_report
text: qcs_id Character vector. One QCS IDs. Provide want process data using QCS IDs. long_table Character. Path single CSV/TSV file tidy 'long table' drug-response data (shape data_imported object). Provide import tabular data directly, without going screening system. file must contain Gnumber, clid, Duration, Concentration, ReadoutValue columns (plus optional Gnumber_2/Concentration_2 combinations). See load_long_table. manifest Character. Path manifest file(s). Can single path, comma-separated string paths, regular expression pattern match files directory (e.g., "/path//manifests/*.xlsx"). Required using qcs_id prism_data_path. treatment Character. Path treatment file(s). Can single path, comma-separated string paths, regular expression pattern. Required using qcs_id prism_data_path. raw_data Character. Path raw data file(s). Can single path, comma-separated string paths, regular expression pattern. Required using qcs_id prism_data_path. prism_data_path Character. Path PRISM data file. Provide want process PRISM data. cell_line_data_path Character. Path cell line data file. Required using prism_data_path processing PRISM level 6 data. treatment_data_path Character. Path treatment data file. Required using prism_data_path processing PRISM level 6 data. drug_annotation_path Character. Path drug annotation CSV file. param can used using custom annotations drugs. Annotation file drugs contain Gnumber, DrugName, drug_moa columns. cell_line_annotation_path Character.  Path cell line annotation CSV file. param can used using custom annotations cell lines. Annotation file cell line contain clid, CellLineName, Tissue, ReferenceDivisionTime, subtype, parental_identifier columns. meta_data_path Character. Path metadata file describing cancer models/cell lines referenced dataset contained within DepMap portal. usually file named Model.csv. Required using prism_data_path feat_data_path Character. Path directory containing molecular feature set files load DepMap. feature_sets Character. Vector containing names molecular feature sets load DepMap. names also correspond file names containing feature data feat_data_path (without extension, assumed csv) Required using special_sections equal "PRISM" metadata_columns Character. Metadata names file pointed meta_data_path Required using special_sections equal "PRISM" output_dir Character. Directory store reports output data. required parameter. viz_format Character. Format visualizations. Default "svg". rmd_template_path Character vector. One directories holding RMarkdown templates. Directories searched order first match wins, deployment can override individual templates supply steps directories carry (instance publication step living outside open-source template set). required parameter. steps Integer vector. Steps run pipeline: 1: data import, 2: processing QC, 3: analysis, 4: publish results. Default 1:3. Note: mae provided, steps 1 2 automatically skipped. mae MultiAssayExperiment Character. MultiAssayExperiment object path .qs2 file containing MultiAssayExperiment object. special_sections String NULL. Provide want process data, type PRISM chemical genomics, starting mae see section specific . One : "PRISM", "chemical_genomics". verbose_mode Logical. Whether generate detailed report, including detailed visualizations cell line name drug name. also affects output directory naming. with_decoding logical whether feature OmicsArmLevelCNA, OmicsSomaticMutationsMatrixHotspot OmicsSomaticMutationsMatrixDamaging encoded 0-1 scheme dpi number defining dpi images report embed Logical. Whether generate self-contained HTML report. configuration_file_path Character. Path configuration file. Currently, required Incucyte data remove_on_failure Logical. Whether remove output directory pipeline fails. Default TRUE. set FALSE, incomplete output kept debugging. resume Logical. Whether resume execution existing 'current' output directory instead creating new version. Default FALSE. extra_render_params Named list. Additional parameters injected every RMarkdown template alongside ones derived arguments . Use pass values specific given deployment (e.g. dataset registry metadata) without adding signature function. Values also persisted args.qs2. Names colliding parameters computed function dropped warning. Default empty list. on_resolve_inputs Function NULL. Hook called data type determined, used resolve input paths external source. receives args (list input arguments) extra_render_params, must return list exactly two elements, replace originals. fields describing inputs (e.g. manifest, treatment, raw_data) may rewritten; rewriting run-control arguments (output_dir, rmd_template_path, steps, verbose_mode, resume, remove_on_failure) raises error. hard boundary rather convenience check: rewriting steps change run actually renders append publication step behind back caller decided steps run. Default NULL (resolution). on_start Function NULL. Hook called output directory exists rendering starts, e.g. notify user run began. receives output_dir. Errors raised hook abort run. Default NULL. on_before_render Function NULL. Hook called data type determined file staged, e.g. verify connectivity external services. receives data_type. Errors raised hook abort run. Default NULL. on_success Function NULL. Hook called steps rendered successfully, e.g. publish results notify user. receives output_dir. Errors raised hook caught reported warning, failing notification discard otherwise successful run. Default NULL. on_failure Function NULL. Hook called run fails, output directory cleaned , e.g. notify user. receives output_dir error_message. Errors raised hook caught reported message. Default NULL.
